headline: Vivek Biyani files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Vivek Biyani has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Future Market Networks Limited. The filing triggers mandatory open-offer or exemption review under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Vivek Biyani submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandated when an acquirer crosses the 25% shareholding threshold or makes subsequent acquisitions that trigger reporting. The disclosure initiates a regulatory clock: SEBI and the target company have fixed timelines to determine whether an open offer is required, unless an exemption applies (e.g., creeping acquisition relief under Reg 23A or personal circumstances under Reg 23B). Future Market Networks Limited operates a derivatives trading platform and data services; the identity and intent of Biyani and any group affiliations will be material to exemption eligibility and SEBI's review.
